facts.fact: INNORPI, the Institut National de la Normalisation et de la Propriete Industrielle, issued standardization bulletin no. 441 on 25 May 2026 opening a two-month public enquiry on draft Tunisian standards under law 38-2009 and decree 2011-1083; the drafts (measurement, quality management, electrical and fibre-optic cable standards) include no information technology, information security, software or data standard.

systems.country_label: Institut National de la Normalisation et de la Propriete Industrielle

note: Not recorded as published or none: one enquiry bulletin is not the catalogue, and its fibre-optic cable and measurement standards are not IT or data standards; no certification stated.
